subject: Facial Recognition | Working w/ Onfido, Veriff & Paravision
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw your facial recognition model was featured on the NIST leaderboard so
I wanted to reach out. We work on projects with Onfido, Veriff and
Paravision on developing similar identity verification models, thought it
might be worth connecting.

For context, Encord is a computer vision and multimodal data development
platform. We help over 200 AI teams accelerate model development by
consolidating & automating training dataset preparation under one platform
(curation, annotation and model evaluation.)

Given your experience in leading computer vision co's - we'd love to get
your feedback on what we've built. Let me know if you're open to a quick
chat Wednesday or Thursday this week?
